entities.name: Arrival at Tocasia's Digsite
entities.description: Event in 10 AR when Urza and Mishra arrived at Tocasia's Digsite with Bly's caravan.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother of Mishra, who came to Tocasia's dig site as a boy.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza, who came to Tocasia's dig site as a boy.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Archaeologist who ran the dig site and took in the brothers.

entities.name: Bly
entities.description: Greedy merchant whose caravan brought the brothers.

entities.name: Richlau
entities.description: Older digsite member who scuffled with Mishra over a bunk bed.

entities.name: Tocasia's Digsite
entities.description: Archaeological dig in the desert where the brothers grew up.

entities.name: Penregon

events.summary: Urza and Mishra arrive at Tocasia's Digsite with Bly's caravan.
events.quote: the two brothers Urza and Mishra arrived at Tocasia's Digsite

events.summary: Tocasia intervenes in the argument and finds a letter from the boys' father asking her to take them on board.
events.quote: Tocasia intervened, finding a letter from the boys' father asking her to take them on board.

events.summary: The brothers scuffle with Richlau over Mishra taking his bunk bed.
events.quote: they immediately got into a scuffle with the much older Richlau for Mishra having taken his bunk bed

events.summary: Tocasia, Urza and Mishra discover a broken ornithopter in the desert.
events.quote: The three discovered a broken ornithopter in the desert after some years

relations.quote: the two brothers Urza and Mishra arrived at Tocasia's Digsite

relations.note: Took the boys in and grew close to them.
relations.quote: Over the years, Tocasia and the two boys grew closer
